content:
I've had the privilege of experiencing the facilitator's coaching in the program The Art and Science of Coaching, and what stands out for me is his ability to create clarity where there is noise. He listens deeply, asks the questions that matter, and holds the space with such presence that you can't help but reflect and move forward with confidence.

What makes the facilitator exceptional is the balance he brings, rooted in strong coaching fundamentals yet always forward-looking in how he enables growth & you. He doesn't give you the answers; he helps you discover your own, and that makes the change sustainable.

In my journey with him, I have walked away not only with deep insights about myself but also with a stronger sense of direction and ownership. His coaching has been a catalyst for both personal effectiveness and leadership growth.

If you are looking for a coach or a program that combines wisdom, professionalism, and genuine belief in people, the facilitator is someone I would wholeheartedly recommend.
name: Geeta Naidu Khan

content: I had the pleasure of attending a program under the facilitator on the 'Art and Science of Coaching' and its been a great learning experience. the facilitator has a unique style and engages very well with everyone in the group and brings out the curiosity and interest in all of them. He is a master in the art of coaching and his ability to ask the right questions and to zero in on specific issues is amazing.. Lastly, his passion for the profession of coaching and to enable others to grow in this field is very impressive and inspirational...
name: Narsimha Rao Mannepalli

content:
the facilitator is deeply immersed in nuturing coaches and his vision of ensuring one coach in every Indian family is truly remarkable. He personifies passion for coaching in every session. He focuses on synthesizing key frameworks, keeps nudging us to practice and brings inspiration from multiple facets of life. Kudos to the high level of engagement he fosters in every session.

My greatest takeaway from the coaching journey has been his sincere & timely reminder to all of us on who we are becoming in this journey as a coach and more importantly as a human being. 

I wish him great luck in his mission.
name: Saikat Saha

content: My commitment is 1%higher than what you are committed to Put in! That's what the facilitator Said and it stuck with me. He is a master facilitator—authentic, genuine, and truly invested in each participant's growth. The way the training was designed and conducted made it feel transformative. Coaching is both an art and a science, and the facilitator demonstrated that beautifully. I'm grateful to have been part of this experience. Thanks the facilitator and team Xmonks.
name: Dhiraj Sorte

content: the facilitator had been my mentor during my coaching journey that I embarked with Erickson Coaching. The program around Art & Science of Coaching was indeed powerful & beyond what I expected during the start of my journey. The program had taught me to ask myself the most powerful question of "Who I am becoming". It has deep reflection, self awakening & navigate into the unknown. The content is quite transformational for me. I would highly recommend this program for people who are willing to traverse this path of self awareness & acceptance & got an inner calling of making some really deep impact in lives of people. This is beyond framework & processes. A big shoutout to the facilitator on building this powerful content & inspiring all of us each time & every time with thought provoking questions about oneself. Shukran the facilitator for being there for us & building this tribe of coaching culture in India
name: Sugata Roy

content:
I had the opportunity to have the facilitator as my facilitator for the Coaching certification on ACC . the facilitator has an amazing ability to connect through sharing his own experiences and leverages that while talking about concepts . Our sessions were always warm, insightful and reflective . He is a charismatic facilitator with a lot of solid content ! 
Our sessions were a great mix of theory, practice and discussions and loved the bonding that we all had post the sessions . Looking forward to do the next level with you as well !
name: Ruchika Sharma

content: the facilitator is a very passionate and an amazing Coach Trainer which I got to know only when I enrolled for 'The Art and Science of Coaching Certification Program' from Erickson Coaching International. During the journey, I realized that it is not about learning a new skill, it is actually a journey of 'Know Thyself' first before you extend a helping hand to another person as a Coach. The program is designed in such a way that it gives you enough opportunity to unlearn, learn, talk to like-minded peers, observe, discuss the learnings, practice and all that in a very psychologically safe and a comfortable environment. Thank you, the facilitator, for your guidance as I continue this learning journey and strongly recommend others who are interested and want to explore Coaching.
name: Arijit Das
